presentation.summary: Sends approved movie and series requests to Scryer, which searches for them and downloads them.
presentation.description_markdown:
When a request is approved, the plugin adds the title to Scryer as monitored and starts Scryer's automatic search. Scryer picks the release with its own quality profile and hands it to its download client. Silo shows the download's progress on the request, and completes the request once the title reaches the library.

Series are requested whole; Scryer's monitoring decides which seasons it fetches. Anime requests go to Scryer's anime library.
presentation.setup_markdown:
1. In Scryer, create an API key under your profile's **API keys**.
2. In Silo, add a request server of type **Scryer** with Scryer's URL (for example `http://scryer:8080`, plus any base path) and the key, and run the connection test.
3. In Silo's request routing, send movies and series to the Scryer server.

capabilities.description: Adds approved requests to Scryer and follows their downloads.

fields.label: Anime movies library
fields.description: Scryer movie library that receives anime movies. Choose Scryer's default movie library to leave them there. Only libraries the API key can add titles to are listed. If the chosen library is later deleted, anime movies go to the default movie library again. Scryer matches existing titles within one library, so an anime movie already in another movie library is added again here.

fields.label: Series and anime monitoring
fields.description: Which episodes Scryer monitors (and so downloads) when a series or anime is requested without a season list, which is a series that has not aired yet. A request that names seasons monitors those seasons whole. Only affects new titles, so Scryer's current state is never changed.

options.label: Leave to Scryer
options.description: Send no monitoring choice. A new series has every episode monitored; one already in Scryer keeps its monitoring.

options.label: All episodes
options.description: Every episode, including already aired ones.

options.label: Missing and future episodes
options.description: Everything Scryer has no file for, plus future episodes.

options.label: Future episodes only
options.description: Episodes that have not aired yet. No backlog download.

fields.label: Monitor specials of new series
fields.description: Scryer has no setting for the specials of series: they are never monitored, unlike anime, which follow the anime specials setting in Scryer. With "Monitor specials of new series" on, a new series requested from Silo gets its specials monitored (and so downloaded). Off (default): Scryer decides, so they are not. Anime always follow Scryer, and titles Scryer already has keep theirs. Silo can't request specials, so this is the admin's decision.

fields.label: Tag titles on Scryer
fields.description: Adds the tags "silo-request" and "silo-user-<username>" to every title the plugin adds or changes, so Silo requests can be filtered and managed together. A title Scryer already had is tagged only when a request monitored something in it. The user tag names the Silo account (shared by its profiles), using only letters, digits and dashes. The tags are created in Scryer when missing. The Scryer API key needs the permissions "Manage titles" and "Manage catalog settings".

queued.label: Searching
queued.detail: Scryer is looking for a copy.
